assessment: The manuscript by Barruet et al., investigates an interesting and rare skeletal muscle dystrophy (FOP). They use both primary and induced (iPSC) muscle stem cells to determine how regeneration/engraftment is affected in this condition. The authors use a blend of histology and transcriptional approaches to determine ECM remodeling and myogenic capacity from both cell/tissue lines. The experiments are well conducted and use strong approaches and statistical measures to test their hypothesis. Overall, this is a quality manuscript on a rare muscle disease that will establish a novel model to study FOP and initial data to elucidate the molecular pathology of HO.
